assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Each cell has one full-body small crisp Neo Geo style pixel-art soldier, same scale, generous transparent margins, feet centered near 85 percent of cell height. Row1: Marco, recognizable muscular blond male with red bandana, red vest, tan pants and boots, gun held aiming right, four DIFFERENT frames of a running cycle facing east. Row2: same Marco four running frames facing up/north, three-quarter rear view. Row3: Fio, recognizable orange baseball cap, round glasses, long brown hair, olive beige military vest and shorts, boots, gun held aiming right, four DIFFERENT running frames facing east. All sixteen figures centered separately in their equal cells, no clipping or overlaps, identical feet alignment in each row. It is essential that legs alternate between contact and passing poses in consecutive columns. No background, no lettering, no shadows beyond tight feet shadow. Square spritesheet.
